title: nanobot
intro: nanobot, headless over `nanobot agent -m`, on an Anthropic-shaped provider through `$HOME/.nanobot/config.json`, where `${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}` and `${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL}` are expanded from the environment at load.
notes: Installed with pip into its own venv.
`-s $HI_SESSION` resumes the same conversation; `-w $HI_WORKSPACE` makes its tools run in the workspace (it seeds a few of its own files there).
